description: Implementation of a fake video encode accelerator class for testing purposes, including methods for initialization, encoding, buffer management, and configuration.

classes.name: FakeVideoEncodeAccelerator
classes.description: A mock implementation of a video encoder for testing, simulating encoding behavior and buffer management.

classes.name: FakeVideoEncodeAccelerator::FrameToEncode
classes.description: A structure representing a video frame scheduled for encoding, including frame data and keyframe flag.

methods.name: GetSupportedProfiles
methods.description: Returns a list of supported encoding profiles with maximum resolution and framerate.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with configuration, client, and media log; returns success status.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Queues a frame for encoding, with an option to force keyframe.

methods.name: UseOutputBitstreamBuffer
methods.description: Provides an output buffer for encoded data.

methods.name: RequestEncodingParametersChange
methods.description: Requests change in encoding parameters such as bitrate and framerate.

methods.name: SetWillInitializationSucceed
methods.description: Sets whether initialization should succeed or fail.

methods.name: SetWillEncodingSucceed
methods.description: Sets whether encoding should succeed or fail.

methods.name: NotifyEncoderInfoChange
methods.description: Notifies client of encoder info changes.

methods.name: IsGpuFrameResizeSupported
methods.description: Indicates if GPU frame resize is supported.
